title: Germany: LUCID registration and dual-system contract
summary: Packaging subject to system participation must be registered in the LUCID packaging register before it is placed on the German market, and a contract with a dual system must be in place.

sources.title: Zentrale Stelle Verpackungsregister — LUCID
sources.note: Article reference inherited from 02-technical-plan §5.1/§5.2, which itself states that article numbers must be verified against EUR-Lex before publishing. Not yet verified.
